/> <if condition='hddObjRep '=""' > <true> <if condition='hddObjRep.Rep '=""' > <true> <assign value='hddObjRep.Rep' property='target.{PIDgrpgrp(1).PIDgrp.PID:Sex}' action='set' /> </true> </if> property='target.{PIDgrpgrp().ORCgrp().OBXgrp()}' action='set' /> <foreach property='target.{PIDgrpgrp(1).ORCgrp()}' key='k1' > <assign value=' ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Interface.Utility).GetHddObject(context.hddRepResponse, "OBR25"_k1)' property='hddObjObrResp' action='set' /> <if condition='hddObjObrResp '= ""' > <true> <if property='hddObjObxResp' action='set' /> <if condition='hddObjObxResp '= ""' > <true> <if condition='hddObjObxResp.Rep '= ""' > <true> <trace value='"The Rep value of OBX-11[ "_k1_"]["_k2_"] is "_hddObjObxResp.Rep' /> <assign value='hddObjObxResp.Rep' property='target.{PIDgrpgrp(1).ORCgrp(k1).OBXgrp(k2).OBX:ObservationResultStatus}' action='set' /> </true> </if> </true> </if> </foreach> </foreach> <trace value='"#### DTL:END ####"' /> </transform>
